name: kolu-claude-code
//acp: The Claude Code ACP ENGINE rides a door of its own (`./acp`) — the leg that reads this adapter's wire, the probe that seats it on a host, and the sentence a host without it is owed. It shares no graph with the rest of this package: padi imports it to register the engine, and nothing it reaches touches the transcript machinery `.` is made of. The note lives OUTSIDE `exports`: a key there that does not start with `.` is read as a CONDITION, and mixing conditions with subpaths makes Node refuse the whole map — which silently broke `kolu-claude-code/schemas` for every consumer.
